### Schneider National, Inc. to report Third Quarter 2026 Earnings on October 29, 2026


October 1, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s28.q4cdn.com/901178831/files/doc_news/Schneider-National-Inc--to-report-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-on-October-29-2026-2026.pdf)


GREEN BAY, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Schneider (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, today announced it will report its third quarter 2026 results after market close on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call to discuss results at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time that day.


**Conference call details:**


**Date:** October 29, 2026


**Time:** 4:30 p.m. ET


**Dial-In-Numbers:**


- 833-461-5787 (toll-free)
- 585-542-9983
- Conference ID: 622 692 953


The Company will also host a live webcast of its conference call, which may be accessed in the[Investor Relations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.schneider.com%2Finvestors%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54614642&newsitemid=20261001704136&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor+Relations&index=1&md5=8e690b4d870c8d948ce1ff4a80b8d790) section of the Company's website ([schneider.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.schneider.com&esheet=54614642&newsitemid=20261001704136&lan=en-US&anchor=schneider.com&index=2&md5=dc44f2e33338d3005e9c99a62c18b2e4) ), along with the current quarterly investor presentation.


**About Schneider**


Schneider is a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, helping customers turn supply chain complexity into greater control. Backed by more than 90 years of operational expertise and innovation, Schneider delivers reliable, flexible and responsible solutions that help businesses move freight with confidence.


Schneider’s broad portfolio includes[Regional](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fschneider.com%2Ffreight-shipping-solutions%2Fregional-haul&esheet=54614642&newsitemid=20261001704136&lan=en-US&anchor=Regional&index=3&md5=4942b56419a0e621863dd65caca03476)
